description: Needs the user's AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence (monthly, annual, team or member licence); no AI is used and no AI analysis is counted. Returns any of the 49 pain points of the Painpoint Atlas by its id (PP01 to PP49): what happens, the number of documented findings and contexts, the years observed, cause, lever, an anonymised example from practice and the Workbench tool or advisory route that addresses it. Adds the profile over all findings of this pain point (type of waste, cause, lever, AI fit, recommendation) and up to five individual findings per call (year, process, activity, waste, cause, lever, severity, AI fit); page 2, 3 and so on return the next five. For the 37 pain points that are not open on the website, each licence can read up to 60 different findings per calendar month; only the finding numbers read are counted, no content and no name. There is no list and no export. Findings are anonymised, coded observations from practice, not market statistics; AI fit and lever are a professional assessment. For use inside the licence holder's own organisation; please name KULIC Advisory as the source.

id.description: Id of the pain point, PP01 to PP49, from atlas_overview or find_painpoint.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

page.description: Page of individual findings, five per page. Default 1.

name: get_painpoint_full
title: Read any pain point of the full Painpoint Atlas with its findings (AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence)
